text: Yes, I think they should. Uniforms make all students equal, so nobody feels bad about their clothes. Also, parents don't need to spend a lot of money on fashionable things. But some students say a uniform is boring and they want to show their personality. In my opinion, schools can choose a simple uniform and let students add something small, like a bag or a badge.

tips.en: Set opening phrases (In my opinion, I'd say) sound natural in spoken answers.
tips.kk: Тұрақты кіріспе тіркестер (In my opinion, I'd say) ауызша сөйлеуде табиғи естіледі.
tips.ru: Устойчивые вводные формулы (In my opinion, I'd say) звучат естественно в устной речи.

tips.en: Contrast words (but, however, whereas) show that you can see both sides of the issue.
tips.kk: Қарама-қарсы байламдар (but, however, whereas) мәселенің екі жағын көргеніңізді көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Слова контраста (but, however, whereas) показывают, что вы видите обе стороны вопроса.
tips.example: But some students say a uniform is boring

text: It depends on how much they get. A little homework helps students remember the lesson and become more independent. However, when teachers give too much, children feel stressed and they don't have time for hobbies or sleep. I remember that in high school I did homework until midnight, and it was not effective at all. I think quality is more important than quantity.

tips.en: Hedging language sounds natural and avoids over-categorical claims.
tips.kk: Жұмсартатын сөздер табиғи естіледі, пікірді тым қатаң етпейді.
tips.ru: Смягчающие выражения звучат естественно и не делают утверждение слишком категоричным.
tips.example: It depends on how much they get

tips.en: Contrast words (but, however, whereas) show that you can see both sides of the issue.

tips.ru: Слова контраста (but, however, whereas) показывают, что вы видите обе стороны вопроса.

text: The main reason is flexibility. People can study at any time, for example in the evening after work, and they don't need to travel to a school. Online lessons are also cheaper than private classes. On the other hand, it is easy to lose motivation when nobody is watching you. So I think online learning is great for people who are disciplined.

tips.en: A direct answer followed by a reason makes the response logical and coherent.
tips.kk: Алдымен тікелей жауап, содан кейін себебі — жауап логикалы әрі байланысты шығады.
tips.ru: Сначала прямой ответ, затем причина — ответ звучит логично и связно.

text: A good teacher is patient and explains things clearly. They should also be friendly, because students are afraid to ask questions if the teacher is strict all the time. Another important thing is that the teacher loves the subject, so the lessons are interesting. For example, my English teacher used songs and games, and we learned a lot without noticing. That is the kind of teacher I would like to be.

tips.en: A concrete example makes the idea convincing and shows fluency.
tips.kk: Нақты мысал ойды сенімді етеді және сөздің еркін екенін көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Конкретный пример делает мысль убедительной и показывает беглость речи.
tips.example: For example, my English teacher used songs and games

tips.en: Simple spoken linkers help you move smoothly from one idea to the next.
tips.kk: Қарапайым ауызекі байламдар ойдан ойға еркін өтуге көмектеседі.
tips.ru: Простые разговорные связки помогают плавно переходить от мысли к мысли.
tips.example: Another important thing is that the teacher loves the subject
